dataset: the ABALAMA tree, lottery and surveys, read through Decision Studio and the repaired VOI Analyzer
title: Judge the numbers
prompt: The ABALAMA prospect, in the Decision Tree Builder (money in million USD, already discounted). Root decision with three branches. Drill, cost 47.3, leads to a chance node: Success probability 0.37, Marginal 0.21 paying 96.4, Dry hole 0.42 paying -31.8. After a Success there is a decision: Develop, cost 212.6, leads to a chance node Large probability 0.62 paying 684.2 and Small 0.38 paying 118.9; or Sell paying 268.4. Farm out, no cost, leads to a chance node with the same three probabilities paying 118.5, 22.7 and 0. Walk away pays 0. The ABALAMA lottery (money in million USD). Outcomes and prior probabilities: Large 0.18, Modest 0.34, Dry 0.48. Actions, payoffs in outcome order: Drill cost 62.5 paying 735 / 88 / -52; Farm out cost 0 paying 142 / 34.6 / 0; Relinquish cost 0 paying 0 / 0 / 0. A survey costing 11.4 reads Strong or Weak with likelihoods P(reading | outcome), in outcome order: Strong 0.78 / 0.46 / 0.17; Weak 0.22 / 0.54 / 0.83. A second survey design reads Strong, Mixed or Weak with likelihoods, in outcome order: Strong 0.66 / 0.31 / 0.09; Mixed 0.23 / 0.44 / 0.27; Weak 0.11 / 0.25 / 0.64; value it with no cost. The tree's Large development payoff is linked to a saved Monte Carlo run whose NPV summary is mean 760.5, P90 (low case) 455, P50 721.3, P10 (high case) 1098.4. In the VOI Analyzer the lottery is entered with Drill as the decision and the Strong and Weak readings as indicators whose outcome chances are typed, in percent and outcome order, Strong 37.1 / 41.3 / 21.6 and Weak 6.4 / 29.5 / 64.1; the Weak indicator chance is always 100 less the Strong indicator chance, and the stated outcome chances are the lottery's priors in percent. Read six values. Money to four decimals in million USD; the indicator chance in percent to four decimals. Read the figures in the Decision Tree Builder and the Decision Studio with their Full precision switch on (at the top of each page): they print them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.

dataset: the IDOHO inventory and the IDOHO-2 AFE, read through the repaired risk summary and the partner split
title: Risk, shares and trust
prompt: The IDOHO capital inventory in the Capital Portfolio Studio (money in million USD; NPV percentiles are success-case outcomes, P90 the low case): ID-1 Infill wells: capex 145, NPV P50 118.4, P10 176.2, P90 71.5, chance of success 0.92, loss if it fails 14.6; ID-2 Compression upgrade: capex 215, NPV P50 163.7, P10 241.9, P90 102.3, chance of success 0.86, loss if it fails 23.8; ID-3 Near-field exploration: capex 105, NPV P50 388.5, P10 655.4, P90 198.7, chance of success 0.3, loss if it fails 72.4; ID-4 Water injection: capex 265, NPV P50 231.9, P10 338.6, P90 141.2, chance of success 0.78, loss if it fails 46.3; ID-5 Well interventions: capex 75, NPV P50 47.3, P10 63.8, P90 31.6, chance of success 0.97, loss if it fails 5.1; ID-6 Subsea tie-back: capex 340, NPV P50 402.6, P10 611.3, P90 224.8, chance of success 0.5, loss if it fails 131.5; ID-7 Flare recovery: capex 190, NPV P50 121.2, P10 170.4, P90 79.9, chance of success 0.88, loss if it fails 18.7. Capex limits of 520, 640 and 900. The IDOHO-2 well AFE in the AFE Cost Control Manager, in USD, window 2028-03-06 to 2029-01-19, read as of 2028-10-03: RIG-01 Rig and drilling services: budget 11384650, commitment 1937400, actual 8215730, no entered forecast, progress 67.5 percent; TUB-02 Casing and tubulars: budget 2963180, commitment 0, actual 3148920, no entered forecast, progress 100 percent; CEM-03 Cementing: budget 1476325, commitment 412600, actual 688140, entered forecast 1591870, progress 48 percent; EVL-04 Evaluation and testing: budget 3208470, commitment 1265300, actual 1418260, no entered forecast, progress 37.5 percent; CPL-05 Completion: budget 4719850, commitment 873900, actual 0, no entered forecast, progress 0 percent. Joint venture partners on IDOHO-2: Asabo Oil 37.25 percent, Okwori Energy 18.6 percent, Ebok Resources 9.15 percent; the operator carries the rest. Bill the actuals to date by working interest. Portfolio risk uses the engine default seed and iterations; where an average correlation is stated it is 0.45. Read six values. Portfolio money to four decimals in million USD; the probability to four decimals; USD to the nearest unit. Read the figures in the Capital Portfolio Studio with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.
